title: RescueFile
description: Rescue sequences that cannot fail (design doc 7.7: the classmate who will not wake up). A Trigger with event rescue and this id opens an action panel; the correct steps must be done in order, a myth is answered by a friend and the panel stays open, so the only way out is through the steps. Text lives in content/strings under rescue.<id>.*; how to write one is in docs/authoring/rooms-and-dialogue.md.

id.description: What a rescue Trigger's eventId names.

steps.description: The correct actions, in the order they must be done.

myths.description: Actions that look like help and are not; picking one never harms anyone.

order.description: Every step and myth once, in the order the panel lists them, so the right answers are not simply at the top.

effects.description: What finishing the rescue does, in the dialogue effect syntax with story-event tags (tag:rescued;unlock:alcohol_poisoning).

RescueHelper.description: Someone who takes over a step on their own when the condition holds, such as the roommate the opening card brought along.
